title: Roof & Gutter Rain-Response Check
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=mould:risk OR sourcetype=ecowitt:obs)
| bin _time span=1h
| stats sum(rain_mm) as rain, max(eval(if(location="loft",humidity_pct,0))) as loft_humidity by _time
| eval leak_suspect=if(rain>5 AND loft_humidity>75,1,0)
| where leak_suspect=1
description: Correlates heavy rain with loft humidity spikes to catch a possible roof or gutter leak early.
value: A roof leak often shows first as raised loft humidity after rain; catching it early prevents costly damage.
implementation: Join rainfall with loft humidity in `index=personal`; alert when both spike together.
visualization: Time chart of rainfall against loft humidity.
grandmaExplanation: It links heavy rain with damp in the loft to catch a roof or gutter leak before it causes real damage.
